items.text: The examination input account identifies the selected candidate/configuration/date, original read basis, common operation boundary, receiving contracts and adopted policy, with actual supplied host evidence distinguished from open or unavailable inputs and each unresolved item carried to its stated owner and point of need. Verified by VER-001. [REQ-001; S1–S5, S7]

verification.text: Inspect the input/coordination account against the accepted deliverable, relevant open-issue and dependency rows, catalog/proposal/receiving contracts, adopted policy and supplied candidate evidence. Check exact owner/point-of-need retention and distinguish defined-contract maturity from actual input availability. Produces the input and limitation account for AC-001. [S1–S3, S7, S11]

items.text: Disabled/unavailable external access is explicit; the enabled machine-local App Codex path follows the person's enablement and the host's catalog, validation/application route, autonomy and applicable reserved-act policy. Verified by VER-002. [REQ-002; S8 V4-HI-50–52]

verification.text: On the identified authorized candidate, exercise disabled/unavailable and person-enabled access and compare the external route with the host catalog/validation/autonomy policy. Retain the actual host selection of MCP or CLI, local access evidence and refusals; use upstream fixtures where they establish the intended seam, with their limitations recorded. Produces access and route evidence for AC-002. [S8 §§4, 6–7]

items.text: A completed V4-EXM-25 candidate witness joins App Codex inspection and proposal submission to actual engineer acceptance in SWBPIPE and host application/receipt, preserving original basis, origin and host-view old/new values. An absent human act or unobserved applied outcome is reported but does not satisfy this completed witness. Verified by VER-003. [REQ-003; S7 V4-EXM-25]

verification.text: Observe the connected App Codex inspect/submit journey and engineer acceptance in SWBPIPE, then reconcile host views, original basis and origin with actual application and host receipt. Identify the human actor and distinguish the recording mechanism. A missing act or receipt limits the witness rather than being filled by a successful tool response. Produces the live joined trace for AC-003. [S7 V4-EXM-25; S8 V4-HI-11, 20–25]

items.text: The intervening-edit case refuses stale basis with its reason and does not retarget through a later selection; interruption/lost-acknowledgment evidence follows the original inspection basis, distinguishes actual domain outcome from transport behavior, preserves unknown outcomes and establishes one domain effect for repeated submission when the effect is observed. Unobserved effects retain limited standing rather than a duplicate-safety pass. Verified by VER-004. [REQ-004; S4 d4–d5; S8 V4-HI-23]

verification.text: Exercise an intervening edit, later selection, repeated submission and interruption/lost acknowledgment in the bounded candidate journey. Compare original inspection basis to refusal/application and host receipt, checking one domain effect from domain evidence rather than transport deduplication. Retain explicit unknown outcomes where recovery cannot observe them. Produces adverse/recovery traces for AC-004. [S4 d4–d5; S7 V4-EXM-25; S8 V4-HI-23]

items.text: One new operation is traced across all three channels on the identified candidate; the comparison accounts for availability, meaningful reads/standing, non-mutating checks, invalid/stale refusal, validation, old/new values, application and recovery outcomes. Generated surfaces and additional work are explicit, with gaps and non-comparable observations retained. Verified by VER-005. [REQ-005; S4 d4; S7 V4-EXM-24/25]

verification.text: Trace the one newly added operation through human interface, embedded tool and external adapter, using comparable original model revision and operation semantics. Compare each result category in REQ-005, inspect the actual generated and adapted surfaces and reconcile additional work with the responsible contributor. Produce the three-channel comparison for AC-005. [S4 d4; S7 V4-EXM-24/25]

items.text: The extension account preserves the original absolute promise and OI-003 owner/point of need. It records the actual retain/narrow/defer disposition when supplied and verifies exactly that chosen criterion, including without-other-changes availability if retained; while unruled, it reports the trace and unresolved decision without claiming an extension pass or savings. Pending disposition does not fulfill the eventual selected extension criterion. Verified by VER-006. [REQ-006; S3 OI-003; S6; S7 V4-EXM-24]

verification.text: Compare the extension trace and change account to the preserved original promise and any actual OI-003 ruling. If retained, examine availability on all three surfaces without other changes and with the same availability reasons; for an explicit narrowing/deferment inspect exact scope, supersession and corresponding evidence/remaining work. If unruled, report that no final extension criterion/pass is established. Produces the disposition and claim-limit account for AC-006. [S3 OI-003; S4 d4; S6–S9]

items.text: Evidence includes a positive faithful-recording case for the engineer's actual acceptance with actor, recorder, bound content/scope/purpose, and negatives showing that queued/success/receipt/agent findings do not fabricate acceptance, checking, approval or reliance. The proposal label and content-change lapse preserve those distinctions without introducing an acceptance-before-checking dependency or an unruled reserved-act list. Verified by VER-007. [REQ-007; S4 d3; S8 V4-HI-25, 30–33]

verification.text: Inspect the real acceptance recording in the joined witness as a positive case and exercise false-attribution negatives against the adopted act/record semantics. Check actor versus recorder, content/scope/purpose, accept label, visible lapse on changed bound content and independent standing of checking/approval/reliance. Do not manufacture a professional act to complete a test. Produces the truthful-act evidence for AC-007. [S4 d3; S8 §5; S9 §§4.5, 4.7]

items.text: Every reported result states candidate/configuration/date and observed standing, links host receipts, distinguishes test definition/replay/source/live evidence and actual acts, and records affected rechecks for changed candidates without weaker criteria. Required live completion remains visibly outstanding when only negative, partial, blocked, not-run or inconclusive evidence exists; browser and native evidence keep their respective scope. Verified by VER-008. [REQ-008; S7 §§1–2]

verification.text: Audit the combined results against V4-EXM-01–05 and the shared examination protocol: candidate/configuration/date, actual outcomes, source/replay/live/native/browser limits, receipt references and affected-candidate rechecks. Verify that retained incomplete evidence does not discharge the live witness, and that failures lead to diagnosis/repair without criterion weakening. Produces the evidence-standing account for AC-008. [S7 §§1–2; S8 §9]

items.text: The output and responsibility account attributes each excluded act to the claim/owner enumerated in REQ-009 and each required received contribution to its actual evidence. Neither shared meaning nor this examination transfers construction, human acts or unresolved decisions to the examiner. Verified by VER-009. [REQ-009; CLM-001 through CLM-004]

verification.text: Independently inspect the output/responsibility map against CLM-001 through CLM-004 and REQ-009, resolving each enumerated excluded act to its actual owner and each received contribution to its evidence. Distinguish unresolved policy decisions from the deliverable carrying policy, actual human acts from host recording, and human-relayed handoffs from external adoption. Produces boundary and source-fidelity findings for AC-009. [S1, S3–S5, S8–S10]
